title: Sustainable Business and Policy minor
notes:
General Guidelines
- To complete the Sustainable Business & Policy Summer minor students must complete 5 of the 6 available upper division courses below.
- ENVECON 100 is the only course that may be completed during a Fall or Spring semester. All other courses are only offered during UC Berkeley Summer Sessions
- All courses for the SBP Summer minor are offered in-person so students are required to be on campus in order to complete the minor. There are no remote course offerings for the SBP Summer minor.
- All courses taken to fulfill the minor requirements below must be taken for letter graded credit.
- A minimum grade point average (GPA) of 2.0 is required for courses used to fulfill the minor requirements.
- No more than one upper division course may be used to simultaneously fulfill requirements for a student's major and minor programs.
University Requirements are assigned as part of your major degree program. There are no additional requirements for completing a minor.
College Requirements are assigned as part of your major degree program. There are no additional requirements for completing a minor.
